Custody, digests, and structure are clean: the subject is 0444 at the expected digest and did not move during review, all 155 recordedInputs digests reproduce against live bytes, all 62 structured path/digest pairs in basedOn plus parentReview and file08Pin reproduce, recordedInputs.HEAD equals head equals live HEAD ef219c1, file 08 and COORD match the dispatch, basedOn.d352.role is the sole last-heading claimant, leftoverDesignClosedIfAcceptedAndRecorded is [], leftoverDesign remains [OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING], the v27-to-.v28, v26-to-.v27 and v24-to-.v25 landings are byte-identical to leftover-join.v28, no DR is SATISFIED, prefix exactly at the operative bound survives in every remainder field, and no lineage collapse with g21-fixture-corpus occurs. All three are single-field advances the next successor can make without touching any frozen input.
